items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Ihr Einspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats eingelegt werden; die Monatsfrist rechnet vom Ende des Tages an, an dem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist.
items.computation: The Bescheid is dated Monday 17.03.2025 and was sent by ordinary post. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a tax letter posted since 2025 counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: 17.03.2025 + 4 days = Friday 21.03.2025. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO, counting of the one-month period starts the day after delivery, i.e. from 21.03.2025, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the month ends on the day with the same number one month later: Monday 21.04.2025. That day is Ostermontag (Easter Monday), a public holiday in Saarland, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline shifts to the next business day: Tuesday 22.04.2025.
